notes: VAT 12% on full price, bars and jewellery; no retail exemption (relief only for SSM/trader sales to BSP, RA 11256; BIR RR 4-2020). Jewellery also has 20% excise (NIRC Sec.150). Import duty, making and bar buyback % removed in review round 1: duty rested on Tariff Finder reports, making on guide pages, buyback on a blog report of the Cebuana programme. 21K most traded.
